ops.en: of a wound or sore: to become infected and produce pus; figuratively, of a problem or negative feeling: to worsen because it is not dealt with
ops.cn: （伤口）化脓感染；比喻问题或负面情绪因未处理而不断恶化

ops.note: Noun: an infected sore that has formed pus.

ops.en: a public celebration, festival, reception, or elaborate party, often held to honor someone
ops.cn: 庆典；节日活动；招待会或盛大聚会

ops.en: to honor or celebrate someone with praise, entertainment, or a special event
ops.cn: 隆重庆祝；设宴或举行活动向某人致敬

boundaries.note: Accented form of the same lexeme.

ops.en: to restrict, hinder, or constrain someone's freedom, growth, action, or development
ops.cn: 束缚；限制；阻碍自由、发展或行动

ops.en: frequently and unpredictably changing in tastes, feelings, loyalties, interests, weather, fortune, or other conditions
ops.cn: 反复无常的；在喜好、感情、忠诚、天气、运势等方面经常变化的

ops.en: informal or old-fashioned: to steal something, especially something small or of minor value, often secretly
ops.cn: （非正式/旧式）偷窃，尤指偷偷拿走小件或价值不高的东西

ops.en: obscene, offensive, or strongly morally objectionable, especially of language, jokes, behavior, or material
ops.cn: 下流的；污秽冒犯的；在道德评价上极其肮脏的

ops.en: informal: suspicious, questionable, or not quite right
ops.cn: （非正式）可疑的；不对劲的

ops.meaning_cn: 看起来/让人感觉很可疑、不对劲

ops.note: Literal: relating to, resembling, or tasting/smelling of fish.

ops.en: suitable, appropriate, or right for a particular person, occasion, or purpose
ops.cn: 合适的；恰当的；适宜的

ops.note: Noun: a standardized accessory or component fitted to a larger system.
Noun: an occasion when clothing is tried on and adjusted for fit.

ops.en: a natural ability or talent, or a distinctive stylish and creative quality
ops.cn: 天赋；才华；也指独特而有创意的风格

ops.meaning_cn: 在……方面有天赋/特别擅长

ops.en: very noticeable, confident, colorful, or showy in style, appearance, or behavior
ops.cn: 张扬醒目的；色彩华丽的；行为或风格非常外放的

ops.en: to display something proudly, conspicuously, or ostentatiously in order to attract notice
ops.cn: 炫耀；招摇地展示以吸引注意

ops.note: Rare noun use is lower priority.

ops.boundary: flaunt = display ostentatiously; flout = openly disregard a law, rule, convention, or authority.

ops.en: figurative: to criticize, attack, or condemn someone or something very harshly
ops.cn: 比喻严厉抨击、痛斥某人或某事

ops.note: Literal: strip the skin from an animal or body.

ops.en: of a light or flame: to shine unsteadily, varying quickly in brightness
ops.cn: （灯光、火焰）闪烁、忽明忽暗

ops.en: of an expression, emotion, or thought: to appear briefly and then disappear
ops.cn: （表情、情绪或念头）一闪而过

ops.en: a brief, unsteady flash, movement, expression, or trace of light or feeling
ops.cn: 短暂的闪烁、晃动；一丝短暂的表情或情绪

ops.note: North American woodpecker noun is a separate specialist sense.
Also move rapidly or intermittently back and forth.

ops.en: fickle, irresponsible, easily distracted, or not serious and reliable
ops.cn: 轻浮善变的；不负责任的；容易分心且不可靠的

ops.en: thin, weak, poorly made, or easily damaged
ops.cn: 单薄脆弱的；不结实、容易损坏的

ops.en: figurative: unconvincing, insubstantial, or poorly supported
ops.cn: 比喻站不住脚的；缺乏实质或依据的

ops.en: to turn or toss something over quickly, or make a sudden quick movement or change
ops.cn: 快速翻转、抛转；突然做出快速动作或变化

ops.note: Noun: a sudden quick movement or turn.
Noun: a coin toss used to decide something by chance.

ops.en: to behave playfully toward someone in a way that shows romantic or sexual interest
ops.cn: 调情；以轻松玩笑方式表达浪漫或性兴趣

ops.meaning_cn: 短暂考虑、试探或冒险接近某种可能/风险
ops.definition_en: to consider, experiment with, or come close to a possibility, idea, or risk without fully committing

ops.note: Noun: playful behavior showing sexual or romantic interest.

ops.en: British informal: to sell something, especially aggressively, repeatedly, cheaply, or with heavy promotion
ops.cn: （英式非正式）兜售、卖掉；尤指强力推销或廉价出售

ops.en: to fall, sit, lie, or throw oneself down heavily and loosely
ops.cn: 重重倒下、坐下或瘫倒

ops.en: to fail badly or be unsuccessful
ops.cn: 惨败；彻底失败

ops.en: a complete or conspicuous failure
ops.cn: 彻底失败；失败的事物

ops.note: Noun: the act of falling or throwing oneself down heavily.

ops.en: to struggle, move or act awkwardly, or have serious difficulty making progress
ops.cn: 挣扎；手忙脚乱；陷入困难而难以前进

ops.note: Flesh of flatfish is lower priority.

ops.en: to openly disregard, disobey, or show contempt for a law, rule, convention, or authority
ops.cn: 公然蔑视、违反法律、规则、惯例或权威

ops.value: flout = openly disregard a rule or authority; flaunt = display something ostentatiously.

ops.en: figurative: lightweight, superficial, or lacking serious substance or rigor
ops.cn: 比喻轻浮表面的；缺乏实质、深度或严谨性的

ops.en: an enemy, opponent, or adversary of a person, group, country, cause, idea, or goal
ops.cn: 敌人；对手；可指个人、群体、国家、事业或理念的敌对者

ops.meaning_cn: 强迫某人接受不想要的东西；把某物硬塞给某人
ops.definition_en: to force someone to accept something unwanted or pass something off on them, often deceptively

ops.en: the leaves of a plant, tree, or area of vegetation considered collectively
ops.cn: 叶子总称；植物、树木或一片植被的叶丛

ops.en: to stir up, incite, or encourage trouble, unrest, rebellion, or strong feeling
ops.cn: 煽动；挑起动乱、叛乱、麻烦或强烈情绪

ops.note: Warm-water or medicated-lotion treatment is archaic/specialist.

ops.en: to search widely for food, supplies, or useful resources, as animals or people do
ops.cn: 觅食；四处寻找食物、补给或可用资源

ops.en: lonely, abandoned, very sad, or hopeless in appearance or situation
ops.cn: 孤独凄凉的；被遗弃的；悲伤绝望的

ops.en: a person's strong point, special skill, or area of particular ability
ops.cn: 长处；专长；特别擅长的领域

ops.en: to strengthen, protect, reinforce, or enrich a place, person, argument, body, food, or drink
ops.cn: 加强、保护、巩固；也可指给食物或饮料强化营养

ops.en: to strengthen or protect a place, position, person, argument, or system against attack, weakness, or failure
ops.cn: 加强、防御、巩固某地、立场、个人、论证或系统

ops.en: to add vitamins, minerals, or other nutrients to food or drink
ops.cn: 给食品或饮料强化、添加维生素矿物质等营养素

ops.en: happening by chance or accident rather than by design; in modern use sometimes confused with or influenced by fortunate
ops.cn: 偶然发生的；出于巧合而非计划的；现代用法有时受 fortunate 影响

ops.en: irritable, quarrelsome, stubbornly difficult to manage, or unruly
ops.cn: 易怒好争吵的；难管束的；桀骜不驯的

ops.en: troublesome, unreliable, or difficult to make work properly
ops.cn: 难处理的；容易出问题或不好运作的

ops.en: extremely anxious or agitated, or hurried, desperate, and disorganized in activity
ops.cn: 极度焦急慌乱的；也指行动仓促、拼命而混乱的
